findings.evidence: `Submodule.comap_map_eq (f) (p) : comap f (map f p) = p ⊔ LinearMap.ker f`, mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Span/Basic.lean:538; the three chains at Superfluous.lean:177, Superfluous.lean:190-191, ProjectiveCover.lean:150-151.
findings.fix: Add `theorem sup_ker_eq_top_of_map_eq_top {f : M →ₗ[R] M₂} {L : Submodule R M} (h : L.map f = ⊤) : L ⊔ LinearMap.ker f = ⊤ := by rw [← Submodule.comap_map_eq, h, Submodule.comap_top]` and use it at all three sites (in `bijective_of_comp_eq` with `L := range σ`, discharging `map h (range σ) = ⊤` by `← LinearMap.range_comp, hσ, LinearMap.range_id`).
findings.issue: The step "`map f L = ⊤` implies `ker f ⊔ L = ⊤`" is inlined as the rewrite chain `sup_comm, ← Submodule.comap_map_eq, …, Submodule.comap_top` three times: here in `IsSuperfluous.comap`, at lines 189-191 in `IsSuperfluous.surjective_of_surjective_comp`, and at ProjectiveCover.lean:149-151 in `bijective_of_comp_eq`. Repeated multi-lemma rewriting hides a reusable lemma and breaks together on any Mathlib rename.

findings.evidence: `grep -rn "isSuperfluous_iff\b" TauCeti/` matches only the module docstring line 29 and the declaration line 79 — no uses; contrast `intro K hK` at lines 91, 97, 105, 142, 169, 251.
findings.fix: Delete `isSuperfluous_iff` (the elimination form `IsSuperfluous.eq_top_of_sup_eq_top` is already there and is used); if the intent really is to keep the body opaque, make that true (`private`/`@[irreducible]`) and route every proof through the iff instead of `intro`.
findings.issue: `isSuperfluous_iff` is `Iff.rfl` and unused, and its docstring justifies it by claiming the body of `IsSuperfluous` "is not exposed outside this module" — false: the `def` at line 74 is a plain public, reducible-by-unfolding definition, and every proof in the file (`isSuperfluous_bot`, `.mono`, `.sup`, `.map`, `.comap`, `surjective_of_surjective_comp`, …) opens its goal with `intro K hK`, unfolding that body directly.

summary: Proofs are readable and correctly commented, but one reusable fact (`map f L = ⊤ → L ⊔ ker f = ⊤`) is inlined as the same brittle five-lemma rewrite chain in three places, and `isSuperfluous_iff` is a dead restatement whose docstring asserts a discipline the file's own proofs violate.
